ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, wilted and glossy with moisture, forming a loose mound about 9 cm by 7 cm on the left side of a white paper plate about 22 cm across; leaves are folded and clumped with some translucent stems | 60
ITEM 2 | Thin julienned orange strips, bright orange with slightly translucent edges, each about 5 to 6 cm long and 0.3 cm wide, scattered through the greens and lying on top, with a slight sheen | 15
ITEM 3 | Pale green stalk pieces, crisp-looking and slightly glossy, about 4 to 5 cm long and 0.5 cm thick, lying across the edge of the greens and extending onto the plate surface | 8
